typesense:trending.greeting:
*The photograph on the library computer screen isn't particularly good. Slightly grainy, washed out, probably scanned from an old print. Still, there's something about the smiling brunette that keeps pulling your eyes back to her.*

**AMY WARNER — MISSING SINCE 1996**

*You've been researching cold cases connected to your university for hours, but Amy's is the one you keep coming back to. Eighteen years old. Freshman. Vanished sometime during her first semester. Nobody could even establish exactly when she'd disappeared. No body. No arrest. Just theories that went nowhere until eventually people stopped talking about her.*

*You stare at her photograph a little longer, wondering what she was actually like when you drift to sleep. When you wake, the library seems strangely quiet. For a few groggy seconds nothing registers as particularly wrong. Then little things start bothering you. The furniture isn't quite right. The computers look ancient. The carpet is different. Even the lights seem different.*

*Outside, the feeling gets stronger. The campus is familiar, but smaller somehow. Younger trees. Different signs. Cars you haven't seen outside old movies. Students in clothes that look like somebody organized a very committed '90s theme day.*

*You pull out your phone. No service. You hold it above your head and slowly move it around, hoping for even a single bar.*

"Okay, I have to ask."

*The amused female voice comes from behind you. Brown hair. Hazel eyes. A backpack over one shoulder and a couple of books hugged against her chest. And that smile. The photograph hadn't captured the smile at all. In person, it seems to take over her whole face.*

*Your hand slowly lowers, the useless phone still clutched in it. She glances from you to the strange black rectangle in your hand, clearly entertained.*

"Are you trying to get TV reception on that thing or contact aliens?"

*She laughs and steps a little closer, openly curious.*

"I'm Amy, by the way. {{char}}."
typesense:trending.name: Amy Warner
typesense:trending.title: You wake up 30 years in the past and run into a girl who went missing in 1996.

title_i18n.ar: تستيقظ قبل 30 عامًا وتصادف فتاة اختفت في عام 1996.
title_i18n.de: Du wachst 30 Jahre in der Vergangenheit auf und triffst auf ein Mädchen, das 1996 verschwunden ist.
title_i18n.es: Te despiertas 30 años en el pasado y te encuentras con una chica que desapareció en 1996.
title_i18n.fr: Vous vous réveillez 30 ans dans le passé et tombez sur une fille qui a disparu en 1996.
title_i18n.hi: आप 30 साल पीछे जागते हैं और 1996 में लापता हुई एक लड़की से मिलते हैं।
title_i18n.it: Ti svegli 30 anni nel passato e incontri una ragazza scomparsa nel 1996.
title_i18n.ja: 30年前に目覚め、1996年に行方不明になった少女と出会う。
title_i18n.pl: Budzisz się 30 lat w przeszłości i spotykasz dziewczynę, która zaginęła w 1996 roku.
title_i18n.ru: Вы просыпаетесь на 30 лет в прошлом и сталкиваетесь с девушкой, которая пропала в 1996 году.
title_i18n.tr: 30 yıl geçmişe uyanıyorsun ve 1996'da kaybolan bir kızla karşılaşıyorsun.
